verdict.reason: The reported regression is clear: repr(T[1:]) exposes slice(1, None, None) rather than the familiar slice syntax, and the change formats slices and tuple indices explicitly.
verdict.unchecked_changes: Formatting of tuple indices and slices with explicit stop/step values, and the _BBRepr parameter rename are not directly exercised by the added assertion.
verdict.title: Render slices in T expressions using slice notation
verdict.statement: The representation of a T expression indexed by a slice is not readable or round-trippable in normal slice notation. For example, repr(T[1:]) currently produces "T[slice(1, None, None)]" instead of "T[1:]". Update T-expression formatting so slices appear as standard start:stop:step notation, omitting None components appropriately (including the trailing colon when a step is specified), and ensure tuple indices containing slices are formatted cleanly as well.
